events.name: Claude Solvathon
events.description: Solvathon Is A Three-Stage Al Challenge By TantraFiesta That Simulates Real-World, Time-Bound Problem-Solving To Bridge Theory And Practice,Assessing Teamwork, Creativity, And TechnicalSkills Like Data Wrangling And Open-Ended Problem-Solving.

events.name: Analytica
events.description: Analytica Is Tantra Fiesta's ML/DS Hackathon That Showcases How Computer Science Predicts And Shapes The Future (E.G., Personalized Recommendations), Pushing Participants To Apply Skills Creatively Under Time Limits While Strengthening Problem-S.

events.name: Genathon
events.description: Hackathons Transform Curiosity Into Innovation,Solitude Into Teamwork, And Fear Into Courage,Offering Stage To Showcase Ideas, Creativity,Vision, And Problem-Solving While Emphasizing Strong Teamwork And Dedication-And Ultimately Highlighting Human Potential.

events.name: Last Man Standing
events.description: LAST MAN STANDING Is A CompetitiveEvent For Individuals To Find Vulnerabilities In Web Applications, Al Systems, And Blockchain Frameworks. It Emphasizes The Growing Importance Of Bug Hunters In An Al-Driven Coding Landscape, Focusing On Converting Discovered Weaknesses Into Security Strengths And Advancing Engineering Strategies.

events.name: Trail Tracer
events.description: Trail Tracer Is A Robotics Contest Where Teams Build Autonomous Line-Following Robots To Navigate A Complex Black Path On White With Curves, Loops, Sharp Turns, Junctions, Dotted Lines, Dead Ends, And Surprise Obstacles, Demanding Smart Algorithms, Solid Engineering, And Inventive Design To Finish The Course

events.name: Micromouse
events.description: Micromouse Is TantraFiesta's Robotic Event Where Autonomous Bots Solve A 16 × 16 Maze From A Corner To The Center, Testing Algorithm Design, Decision-Making, Engineering, Teamwork, And Innovation To Highlight The Blend Of Human Creativity And Machine Intelligence.

events.name: Robowars
events.description: Robowars Is A Competitive Arena Battle Where Teams Build And Drive Weaponized Robots (E.G., Spinners, Hammers) To Disable Opponents, Testing Mechanical Design, Weapon Systems, Durability, Control, And Match Strategy.

events.name: Render Riot
events.description: Render Riot I s A 3D Animation Contest That Treats Animation As Expressive Storytelling, Urging Participants To Use Modeling As A Creative Language And Prioritize Artistic Vision, Originality, And Innovation To Turn Imagination Into Motion And Create Emotionally Resonant Work.

events.name: IIITN Game Jam
events.description: Game Jam I s A Fast-Paced Contest Where Teams Build Theme-Based Playable Games, Judged On Creativity, Storytelling, And Technical Quality To Craft Experiences That Evoke Emotion..

events.name: Design-a-thon
events.description: Design-A-Thon Is A UI/UX Competition Where Empathy Leads The Process, Imagination Guides Solutions, Form Bridges Ideas To Users, And Impact Measures Success, Pushing Creative Problem-Solving and Design Method In A competitive Setting

events.name: BrandXperience
events.description: BrandXperience Is A Fast-Paced Branding Contest Where Teams Craft Strategy-Driven, Theme-Aligned Campaigns That Blend Creativity,Storytelling, And Positioning To Influence And Emotionally Connect With Audiences Under Pressure

events.name: Digital Time Capsule
events.description: Digital Time Capsule Is A Creative Media Drive To Capture TantraFiesta'25 Memories, Preserving Selected Submissions In A Capsule To Be Reopened At Next Year's Fest So Everyone Can Relive The Event's Energy And Spirit.

events.name: Algorithmia
events.description: Algorithmia Is A National ICPC-Style Contest Where Three-Person Teams Solve Challenging Algorithmic Problems Under Time Pressure, Showcasing Creativity, Teamwork, And Coding Skill-The Logical Core Of Progress I n Action.

events.name: Codefiesta
events.description: CodeFiesta Is An Online Competitive Programming Contest That Celebrates Problem-Solving As A Creative Craft, Open To Anyone Passionate About Coding, And Emphasizes Speed And Accuracy Under Time Pressure To Help Participants Unlock Their Potential

events.name: Flash Code
events.description: Flash Code Is A Unique And Exciting Onsite Codingcompetition Designed To Test Adaptability, Speed, And Creativity Under Pressure. Unlike Traditional Coding Contests, It Features 3 Surprise Mini-Games, Revealed Only On The Event Day. Each Game Is Scored Separately With Its Own Winners, Making The Event Fast-Paced, Unpredictable,And Full Of Opportunities To Shine.Participation Is Individual-Only, Ensuring Fair Competition For All Coders.

events.name: Women's Only Hackathon
events.description: WomenlnDev Celebrates Calm, Resilient, And Courageous Women, Blending Grace With Power And Purpose. It Empowers Female Developers To Solve Real Problems And Explore New Tech Frontiers, Spotlighting Their Often-Overlooked Impact Through Creativity And Innovation.

events.name: EnigmaXplore 3.0
events.description: EnigmaXplore will be a Capture The Flag - Jeopardy Style, for participants to show their skills in various areas of computing and solve real-life security challenges.

events.name: Circuit Design
events.description: Circuits Aren't Just Wires-They're The Logic That Powers Computation. This Event Challenges Participants To Design And Build Electronic Circuits That Solve Real Problems, Emphasizing Innovation, Precision, And Methodical Problem Solving Using A Simulation Software Under Clear Rules And Creative Constraints.

events.name: VLSI
events.description: The VLSI Design Challenge Tasks Teams With Designing, Simulating, And Optimizing ICs That Power Domains Like AI, loT, 5G, And Biomedical-Balancing Efficiency, Area, Power, And Performance To Solve Real-World Problems And Push Technological Progress.

events.name: Atal Tinkering
events.description: Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL), Under The Government Of India's Atal Innovation Mission, Nurtures Youug Innovators By Giving School Students Space, Tools, And Mentorship To Turn ldeas Into Prototypes And Solutions For Real-World Challenges, Strengthening Creativity, Problem-Solving, And Decision-Making For National Development.

events.name: Bioinformatics - ML Challenge
events.description: A one-of-its-kind Attack & Defense Battle. Don't just solve the problems, also create your own challenges for your peers, but never forget to defend your castle with the incoming ones. With a live leaderboard, points, penalties, and real-world ML problems like gene clustering, protein classification, and cancer prediction, the battle fuses strategy with innovation in ML...

events.name: Finance Case study comp
events.description: FiniX Is A Fintech Hackathon Blending Finance And Al To Explore Modern Financial Innovation, Inviting Participants To Understand Transformation, Build Novel Solutions, And Reimagine The Future Of Money.

events.name: Quantum
events.description: The Quantum Computing Hackathon Is A Learning-First, Build-Fast Event That Readies Future Innovators To Apply Quantum Principles To Real-World Problems Across Domains Like Optimization, Materials, Finance, And Security, Reflecting The Field's Profound But Emerging Potential To Reshape Technology And Society.

events.name: Web 3
events.description: The Blockchain Hackathon At TantraFiesta, Hosted By IIIT Nagpur And Powered By The Bhaisaaab Community, Invites Builders To Spark Decentralized Innovation By Diving Deep Into The EVM Stack, Experimenting With Smart Contracts, And Rapidly Prototyping Solutions Across DeFi, RWA, DeFAL, Interoperability, And MoreReimagining Trust, Transparency, And Collaboration For The Digital Age.

events.name: CodeDuelz
events.description: CodeDualz ls A Knockout, Face-To-Face DSA Duel Where Teams Race Through Rounds To Crown A TantraFiesta'25 Champion On The Main StageEarly Rounds Prize Consistency; Finals Deliver High-Pressure, Live Spectacle.
